review_triggers: Modelled operating funding probability falls below 95%.
Laura's stated objectives or the residency timeline change.
A call or early redemption event occurs.
The payment date this instrument is matched to moves within twelve months.

details.methodology: Holds US Treasuries maturing in 2032, then terminates around 15 December 2032 and distributes the proceeds. Because it winds up in December it can fund a payment due at the start of 2033, not 2032. The distribution is whatever the portfolio is worth on liquidation: the fund does not target a predetermined terminal amount, so this is not a contractual par payment.
